# Skylos Documentation

> Skylos is an open-source, local-first check for code written with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It fails a branch on deleted or skipped tests, packages that don't exist, security bugs, secrets and vulnerable dependencies, and it finds dead code.

Open-source PR gate that checks what AI coding agents changed before merge. The CLI is free (Apache-2.0) and needs no account, API key or LLM for its core checks. Skylos runs alongside Ruff, Bandit, Semgrep, CodeQL and Vulture rather than replacing them. Available as CLI, agent hooks, MCP server, VS Code extension, and GitHub Action.

## If you are a coding agent

1. Install (Python 3.11 or newer): `pip install skylos`
2. Install the hooks once per repository, so your edits, file reads, package installs and git commands are checked while you work:
   - Claude Code: `skylos agent install-hooks` (writes `.claude/settings.json`)
   - Codex: `skylos agent install-hooks --codex` (writes `.codex/hooks.json`)
   - Cursor: `skylos agent install-hooks --cursor` (writes `.cursor/hooks.json`)
3. Before you report a task as done, run `skylos done --base main`. It compares the branch with `main`, runs the tests, and flags deleted, skipped or weakened tests, loosened test settings and CI test steps, silenced lint or type checks, and code that special-cases the tests. Exit `0` pass, `1` blocked, `2` could not run. It reads its settings from the base branch, so fix the code rather than the tests or the Skylos settings.
4. For machine-readable findings on the lines you changed: `skylos . -a --diff origin/main --format json`.

What the hooks block, and what they do not:

- Package installs: blocks packages that don't exist, typosquatted names and known malware, and asks before installs it cannot verify.
- Secrets: blocks the agent's Read tool on files that hold hard-coded secrets, and from 5.7.0 shell commands such as `cat .env` that would print them. It is not a sandbox: a program that opens the file itself is not blocked.
- Git: blocks `--no-verify` and other ways around the repository's git hooks.
- If Skylos itself errors, the action is allowed and you are told it went unchecked.

Details: [Done gate](https://docs.skylos.dev/cli-reference#skylos-done-path), [Agent hooks](https://docs.skylos.dev/supply-chain#in-the-agent-hooks), [Package install checks](https://docs.skylos.dev/supply-chain#package-installs), [Hook limits](https://github.com/duriantaco/skylos/blob/main/docs/agent-hooks.md).

## Languages, per check

Deepest in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Java. Go, PHP and Dart get dead-code and security checks. Rust gets security checks. Ruby, C#, C++, Kotlin, Swift and Shell get partial checks. Full matrix: [Language Support](https://docs.skylos.dev/language-support).

## What Skylos is not

An LLM reviewer, a replacement for Ruff, Semgrep or CodeQL, or a compliance certificate. The core checks are deterministic; LLM features are optional.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://docs.skylos.dev/installation): Install via pip, system requirements, Python 3.11 or newer
- [Quick Start](https://docs.skylos.dev/quick-start): Step-by-step workflow guide
- [Tutorial: setup to PR](https://docs.skylos.dev/workflow): Set Skylos up once and let your coding agent run the checks, through to the pull request check
- [Configuration](https://docs.skylos.dev/configuration): Configure via pyproject.toml — exclusions, thresholds, quality gates
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.skylos.dev/cli-reference): All command-line flags and options

## Command Chooser

- `skylos done --base main`: run the tests and completion checks for a branch and write a receipt to `.skylos/receipts/`.
- `skylos agent install-hooks [--codex|--cursor]`: check every agent edit, file read, package install and git command.
- `skylos cicd init`: write the pull request gate workflow for GitHub Actions or another CI.
- `skylos PATH`: scan source; dead code by default, every main source analyzer with `-a`.
- `skylos verify [PATH]`: scan the selected source for AI-code mistakes; a separate Python behavior result compares supported working changes with Git HEAD.
- `skylos preflight [ARTIFACT]`: statically check an exact local GPU artifact against `.skylos/gpu-targets.yml`; OCI input is identity-only and returns `UNKNOWN` in the CLI.
- `skylos image scan IMAGE@sha256:<digest> --platform os/arch`: ask separately installed Trivy to scan a remote registry image; findings gate only with `--fail-on`.
- `skylos suite [DIRECTORY]`: build one static, debt, defense, and provenance report; findings are report-only by default.
- `skylos defend [DIRECTORY]`: report guardrails for recognized Python and TypeScript/JavaScript LLM integrations; threshold flags or policy enable gating.
- `skylos clean [PATH] --dry-run`: preview Python import/function cleanup without writing.
- `skylos cleanup [PATH] --next`: review detector-backed tasks; explicit options add context, local plans, supported edits and observed test/rescan receipts. See https://docs.skylos.dev/cleanup and check installed `--help` for new options.

## Agent Checks

- [AI Defects](https://docs.skylos.dev/ai-defects): How Skylos verifies evidence-backed failure modes in AI-written code
- [AI Hallucination Contracts](https://docs.skylos.dev/ai-contracts): Repo-specific generated-code contracts for `skylos verify . --contract PATH`
- [Vibe Coding Detection](https://docs.skylos.dev/concepts/vibe-coding): Detecting AI-generated code risks
- [Change Map](https://docs.skylos.dev/change-map): What a change touches before you review it: callers, removed security checks, and what to read first
- [Supply Chain](https://docs.skylos.dev/supply-chain): Malicious, hijacked and brand-new npm and PyPI versions and unpinned MCP servers, checked before a coding agent or CI runs them
- [MCP Server](https://docs.skylos.dev/mcp-server): Connect to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and AI assistants via Model Context Protocol
- [Claude Code Security](https://docs.skylos.dev/integrations/claude-code-security): Security ingestion for Claude Code
- [VS Code Extension](https://docs.skylos.dev/vscode): Real-time analysis in the editor

## Rules for agent-written code

- [SKY-A110 Test Deleted](https://docs.skylos.dev/rules-reference#sky-a110--test-deleted)

- [SKY-A112 Test Settings Loosened](https://docs.skylos.dev/rules-reference#sky-a112--test-settings-loosened)
- [SKY-A115 Test Answer Hard-Coded in Code](https://docs.skylos.dev/rules-reference#sky-a115--test-answer-hard-coded-in-code)

## Dead Code

- [Dead Code Detection](https://docs.skylos.dev/dead-code-detection): Find unused functions, imports, classes, and variables
- [Framework Awareness](https://docs.skylos.dev/framework-awareness): Django, Flask, FastAPI, Pydantic, and pytest recognition to reduce false positives
- [Smart Tracing](https://docs.skylos.dev/smart-tracing): Runtime call tracing for dynamic code
- [Cleanup](https://docs.skylos.dev/cleanup): Review detector evidence, organize local plans, preview supported edits, and record observed tests and rescans
